privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: What this site collects, why, and how to change it. Short, no legalese.

sections.p: Google Tag Manager loads Google Analytics 4 and Google Ads conversion measurement. Until you click Allow, Google only receives anonymous cookieless signals (Consent Mode v2). Once you allow it, cookies record which pages you open and where you came from, so I can tell which campaigns work.
The name, email and message from the form go through Resend straight to my inbox. I use them only to reply and do not share them with anyone.
Only your cookie choice (localStorage, key sepic-consent). The music setting is not stored and sound never starts on its own.
The Cookie settings button in every page footer reopens the choice. To have form data deleted, write to me through the contact page.

privacy.metaDescription: What sepic.me collects (Google Analytics and Google Ads only with consent, the contact form through Resend) and how to change your cookie choice.
